name: How much does it really cost to convert a tub into a shower in San Diego County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it really cost to convert a tub into a shower in San Diego County?

acceptedAnswer.text:
There is no reliable single price because a tub-to-shower conversion can range from a limited replacement to a substantial bathroom remodel. Published consumer estimates commonly place conversions around $2,000 to $12,000, while plumbing changes, premium finishes, custom glass, and concealed damage can push a project higher. Elite Remodeling & Design should price the actual scope after reviewing the room rather than relying on a generic square-foot figure.

Key factors:
- Drain relocation and new supply lines add plumbing labor.
- Tile, waterproofing, glass, fixtures, and wall repairs can vary widely.
- A prefab surround may cost less than a fully tiled enclosure but limits some design choices.
- Permit and inspection costs depend on the local authority and project scope.

Request an itemized proposal with allowances, exclusions, change-order terms, and assumptions about hidden conditions. That comparison is more useful than comparing only the total price.
acceptedAnswer.description: A broad published range is about $2,000–$12,000, but San Diego projects can vary substantially with plumbing, tile, glass, waterproofing, permits, and concealed damage. An itemized proposal from Elite Remodeling & Design is more meaningful than a generic estimate.
